item.title: Kathy Anderson’s Artful Flowers
item.description: A florist is usually focused on creating symmetry, balancing colors and flowers in equal measure, with everything at its peak. These paintings, on the other hand, “look like a garden.”

item.title: John Hull > The Lowdown: The Lost Episodes
item.description: When artist John Hull ventured into a cemetery to gain inspiration for new work, stories started to develop and the characters gathered for the story that he wanted to tell.

item.title: Real, Surreal, and Photoreal
item.description: For a limited time, view paintings, works on paper, and even tapestries made by such talents as John Currin, Salvador Dalí, Carole Feuerman, William Glackens, Alex Katz, Fairﬁeld Porter, Man Ray, and John Sloan.

item.title: Gavin Glakas on Preparing for an Art Show
item.description: Principle Gallery is presenting "Proximate," a contemporary realism show featuring works by Gavin Glakas and Steven S. Walker. Here, Glakas takes us behind the scenes of what it's like to prepare for such a show with an ambitious goal of creating 12 new paintings on a time budget.

item.title: Featured Artwork: Melinda Whitmore
item.description: Melinda Whitmore: Melinda depicts the fullness of ordinary human life—its triumphs and trials—with honesty and candor. She is drawn to the vulnerability and psychology of the figure as much as to its physical form.
